criteria.criterion: Valid supported translations can progress; unjustified lifting from modal-erasing or otherwise lossy projections cannot admit the source claim.
criteria.explanation: exact_atom_supported_progress validated an exact FOL atom to SMT-LIB with matching inventories (formula_root baguqeeramwn36h43fs6gepih7zuv4sw3eylulil7lkgshjh2jqfkc6my3rva, contract baguqeeracai4zl2aauwytjxxyyslormne2aio6n4kwpdialyqof2gblitxwq). validate_translation was conformant and promotion_allowed at solver_checked; admit_receipt admitted the bound non-conclusive solver envelope (caller receipt baguqeerarrvk2uzfp2mcnk6enrwn2fghu6tc52weyejhvth6da5qsfbj2qea) and rejected the same result as kernel proof. TDFOLToFOLConverter mapped O(Done) and Done to the identical FOL atom Done; the exact DCEC obligation translation dropped root:obligation and was quarantined (dropped_modal_operator). admit_receipt rejected source-claim lifting (translation_chain_invalid). SAFETY(p) was false on a partial trace where p held only at step 0. p U q and p ∧ q are distinct sources with the same FOL projection (∧ Done Ready). Declared conservative modal erasure progressed only at candidate assurance and still could not lift.

criteria.criterion: Actual caller receipts bind exact formulas/source/theory/solver/environment and reject stale or unvalidated results.
criteria.explanation: Caller envelopes through SupervisorLogicPlatformReceiptAdmission@1 bound formula_root, source/target forms, theory, solver_id, environment_id env-ns009-sealed, and contract/artifact identities. Stale formula roots failed source_identity_mismatch plus admission source_id_mismatch/freshness. A solver fingerprint that did not match the submitted formula was rejected. Fixture-set mismatch quarantined the artifact. Colliding named assertion IDs bound to distinct formula roots were rejected as assertion-identity replay, not retained solver state. A solver_result labeled proved was rejected for kernel completion (evidence_kind_does_not_support_verdict, reconstruction_not_passed).

criteria.criterion: Vacuity, unknown, unsupported, and budget-exhausted cases remain distinct from meaningful proof.
criteria.explanation: TDFOLProver.prove produced proved (axiom_lookup, non-kernel), unknown (forward chaining exhausted), and timeout (timeout_ms=0) as distinct statuses. Obligation evaluation on the finite-trace evaluator raised unsupported (no reference semantics). Vacuous G⇒A from unsatisfiable G (p ∧ ¬p) held on the trace evaluator and was rejected as kernel proof. SMT SAT and UNSAT of G∧¬A were recorded unavailable because probe_solver_readiness marked Z3 unsupported (backend_unavailable, no binary, no z3 module) rather than simulated sat/unsat. None of these classes was relabeled proved or kernel_proof.

criteria.criterion: Any claimed CEGAR/interpolant/composition behavior is supported by located code and actual evidence; no unavailable mechanism is silently simulated.
criteria.explanation: ipa.refine_spurious_paths is located and was executed: spurious finding f-spurious was refined away and corpus seed f-seed remained corpus_bound. Identifier search found no interpolant checker, no CompositionEdge, no ProcedureCegis, and no incremental SMT wrapper in Python source. The named QF_LIA interpolating CEGAR adapter is not substituted by IPA CEGAR. A purported interpolant whose symbols escaped A∩B was not admitted; Craig implication/UNSAT checks were recorded as not discharged because no interpolant checker exists. Unsat cores are not treated as interpolants. Assertion replay is not retained-clause incrementality. No unavailable mechanism was simulated as success.
